preserve: setting(name) answers the stored value of setting:<name>, or null
setSetting(name, value) writes one setting record and answers the value; null clears it
settings(prefix) lists every setting whose name starts with the prefix, keeping the name boundary explicit
allowed_deltas: the store is the person's list:settings, read through their records door, instead of the decision store's SQLite; settingStore runs over a snapshot of the rows read (snapshotEeaf) and its writes are kept for the caller to send
a setting's name is <workshop-folder>~<scope_kind>~<scope_id> and its row id record:setting:<name>, so one generic list holds every tool's settings at a scope
settingsOf refuses a row of another type, of another tool's folder, a retired row and one with no settings object, saying what to give instead
banned_substitutions: a settings file kept inside a tool instead of a list:settings row
a second settings reader beside this one
